title: Additivity for disjoint events
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $A$ and $B$ be decidable properties of Boolean strings. If no Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies both properties, then the probability that a uniformly random Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies at least one of them is the sum of their individual probabilities.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are decidable properties of Boolean strings
No Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies both $A$ and $B$
